name: racer_slots_init
comment: racer slot bytes 0x0300565C[0..4] = i while i < AI cars + 1; else 0xFF

name: overlay_load
comment: race ARM overlay: first 0xE4 bytes from ROM 0x08165134 to the IWRAM base; overlay pointers 0x03006490..0x030064A0

name: copy_units
comment: copies n bytes as words / halfwords / bytes (unit 0x20 / 0x10 / 8); -1 for a null pointer or too few bytes

name: copy_words
comment: copies n words

name: copy_halfwords
comment: copies n halfwords

name: copy_bytes
comment: copies n bytes

name: overlay_copy
comment: more of the race ARM overlay: words to the IWRAM base + 0xE4 + 4*slot

name: fill_units
comment: fills n bytes as words / halfwords / bytes (unit 0x20 / 0x10 / 8)

name: fill_halfwords
comment: fills n halfwords

name: oam_reset
comment: all 128 OAM entries hidden and copied to OAM; then the shadow reset to 64x64 at (0x3C; 0xA0) with tile 0; OBJ tile base 0x200

name: oam_init
comment: OBJ tile base; shadow OAM cleared; OBJ on; every entry hidden; shadow copied to OAM

name: shadow_oam_clear
comment: clears the shadow OAM 0x030064F0 (0x400 bytes)

name: obj_enable
comment: DISPCNT bit 12 (OBJ on/off)

name: obj_1d_mapping
comment: DISPCNT bit 6 (OBJ 1-D mapping)

name: oam_set_mosaic
comment: attr0 bit 12 (mosaic)

name: oam_set_shape
comment: attr0 bits 14..15 (shape)

name: count_runtime_records
comment: world +0xE0 = walls with a moving piece; +0xDE = sectors with an offsets record

name: init_runtime_tables
comment: moving-piece records get their wall's flags; sector offsets records the sector's flags byte and halfwords +0x14..+0x18

name: link_template_entities
comment: pushes each template entity onto its sector's entity list (world +0x0C heads; entity +0x02)

name: spawn_wingman_marker
comment: with a wingman: a marker entity (model 0x62; material 0x92) in the first free extra slot; 0x80 above the last AI car

name: camera_place
comment: all OAM hidden and copied to OAM; the chase orbit position for the view 0x030055F8 behind the followed entity

name: effect_list_init
comment: effect-sprite list header (count; first OAM entry) and its 0x14-byte objects on the heap

name: sky_gradient_start
comment: gradient read pointer = the gradient buffer; DISPSTAT VCount IRQ enable

name: traffic_init
comment: traffic counters reset; 4 settings; traffic_setting(*0x03005604)

name: traffic_setting
comment: traffic tuning of a setting from 0x087F53EC (0x20 per setting)

name: moving_pieces_init
comment: moving pieces' start state; the route's list 0x087F3A24 (0x10 per route index) starts closed

name: empty_0813b628
comment: empty; called after moving_pieces_init
